issue_context.title: Add embeddings database metrics to `stats` route
issue_context.body:
related PR: TBD

Make the `/stats` route return several metrics related to the embeddings stored in each Meilisearch index.

## Usage

GET: `/stats`

```json
{
  "databaseSize": 438272,
  "lastUpdate": "2025-01-23T11:36:22.634859166Z",
  "indexes": {
    "kefir": {
      "numberOfDocuments": 1,
      "numberOfEmbeddedDocuments": 1,
      "numberOfEmbeddings": 1,
      "isIndexing": false,
      "fieldDistribution": {
        "age": 1,
        "description": 1,
        "id": 1,
        "name": 1,
        "surname": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### field description

- `numberOfEmbeddedDocuments` represents the number of document in an index that contains at least one embedded representation — this is the one we will likely sum at a project level when we bill AI documents in the future
- `numberOfEmbeddings` represents the total number of embeddings representation that exists in that indexes. A document can contains a representation per embedder used. so basically => numberOfEmbeddedDocuments * the number of embedder they have a rep for

## Impacted teams

- @meilisearch/docs-team 
- @meilisearch/integration-team

review_comments: it looks to me like we should update the target version to explicitly be (1, 13, 0)
